_README: Switzerland SECO consolidated sanctions ('Gesamtliste') — maintained in-repo because SECO's portal (sesam.search.admin.ch) serves an HTML page to automated GETs, not raw XML, so it cannot be fetched directly. To turn SECO into a DIRECTLY-screened list: download the official list (CSV or XML) from https://www.seco.admin.ch/en/searching-for-subjects-sanctions, paste each designated party's full name into `entries` (a plain string, or {"name":"...","aliases":["..."]} for AKAs), update `count` + `lastReviewed`, then set this source's `enabled:true` in data/sanctions-extra.json. While `entries` is empty the source stays disabled so it never reports a false clear or a permanent 'degraded' flag. Most SECO designations already mirror the UN/EU lists screened directly. ACTIVATION: the switch is the 'ch-seco-curated' source in data/sanctions-extra.json (file+curated parser) — flip its enabled:true after populating entries; nothing reads this file until then.
